en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from one of his companions, from Suleuyman Bin Ja’far Al Ja’fary, from his father, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Allahazwj Blessed and High Necessited the five (daily) Salaats and Made to be for the deceased, one Takbeer from each Salaat’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from certain persons of his people from Sulayman ibn Ja‘far al- Ja‘fariy from his father who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Allah, most Blessed, most High, made five Salah (prayer) obligatory, and from every Salah (prayer) there is one Takbir (Allah is great beyond description) in Salah (prayer) for a deceased.’”
